title: plan/queue.json
description: Open steps only. A finished step leaves the file; its record is the commit with a Step: trailer.

next_id.description: Number for the next new step, S<next_id>

owner.description: Role that does the step, such as builder

tier.description: S small, M normal, L risky

model.description: Model alias for the role agent, such as opus

after.description: Steps that must be done first

verify.description: Command that proves the step works, or none for a prose step

review.description: Role that reviews the step, or none

context.description: The only files the agent opens besides its step file
